Reason: The lateral view (Figure 1b) clearly localizes the large opacity to the posterior aspect of the thorax, confirming a posterior mediastinal mass. The frontal view (Figure 1a) shows near-complete opacification of the right hemithorax with compression of the right lung, while the trachea remains midline and the cardiac silhouette is not significantly displaced, matching the description in option C.
